supportBoundary.limitation: Plugin installation does not register custom agent roles on Codex CLI 0.153.0.

delivery.boundary: The PowerShell ownership installer is a separate delivery path from plugin-native skill packaging.

assets.name: backend-patterns
assets.purpose: Review backend boundaries and reliability from repository evidence.
assets.activation: Load when backend ownership, persistence, retries, queues, caching, or API boundaries matter.
assets.outputContract: Evidence-bound backend findings or implementation guidance.
assets.overlap: Complements software-architecture for backend-specific evidence.

assets.name: concurrency-performance
assets.purpose: Diagnose concurrency correctness and measured performance bottlenecks.
assets.activation: Load for concurrency hazards or evidence-backed performance work.
assets.outputContract: Measured diagnosis, bounded change, and verification evidence.
assets.overlap: Owns concurrency and measurement details beyond general architecture.

assets.name: continuous-learning
assets.purpose: Create review-gated reusable engineering-pattern candidates.
assets.activation: Load only when extracting a reusable lesson from completed evidence.
assets.outputContract: A sanitized pending-review candidate, never automatic promotion.
assets.mutation: Writes only through the explicit review-gated learning workflow.
assets.overlap: Does not replace documentation or add active skills automatically.

assets.name: eval-harness
assets.purpose: Define capability and regression evaluations with deterministic graders first.
assets.activation: Load when ordinary tests do not fully express agent or workflow success.
assets.outputContract: Versioned cases, graders, and explicit pass or failure evidence.
assets.mutation: Parent task controls eval artifact writes.
assets.overlap: Complements verification-loop without replacing project-native tests.

assets.name: frontend-patterns
assets.purpose: Review frontend ownership, rendering, state, accessibility, and data flow.
assets.activation: Load when frontend implementation or review needs domain-specific evidence.
assets.outputContract: Evidence-bound frontend findings or implementation guidance.
assets.overlap: Complements software-architecture for frontend-specific evidence.

assets.name: orchestrator
assets.purpose: Route engineering work to the smallest relevant role, skill, and workflow.
assets.activation: Load for multi-stage engineering work requiring explicit routing.
assets.outputContract: Selected roles, evidence, work result, verification, and readiness state.
assets.mutation: Delegated work retains its own mutation boundary.
assets.overlap: Routes other assets; it is not an autonomous agent or universal knowledge pack.

assets.name: software-architecture
assets.purpose: Design and review architecture from repository evidence.
assets.activation: Load for material boundary, ownership, deployment, or migration decisions.
assets.outputContract: Current state, proposed boundary, tradeoffs, migration, rollback, and verification.
assets.overlap: Broader design skill; the architect role or agent supplies a focused operating context.

assets.name: verification-loop
assets.purpose: Run evidence-based release and change-readiness checks.
assets.activation: Load after significant changes and before readiness claims.
assets.outputContract: Executed checks, results, missing evidence, and readiness status.
assets.mutation: Verification is read-only except for ordinary test artifacts.
assets.overlap: Coordinates existing gates; it does not replace their tests or graders.

assets.name: architect
assets.purpose: Provide isolated read-only architecture review.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local architect agent.
assets.outputContract: Evidence-grounded architecture findings and bounded recommendations.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to the architect parent-context role contract.

assets.name: build-resolver
assets.purpose: Resolve a bounded build failure in an isolated worktree.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local build-resolver agent.
assets.outputContract: Root cause, minimal fix, changed files, and scoped verification.
assets.mutation: Controlled write in the assigned isolated worktree.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to build-error-resolver with a shorter runtime name.

assets.name: docs-researcher
assets.purpose: Research version-scoped first-party documentation in isolated context.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local docs-researcher agent.
assets.outputContract: Concise sourced evidence separating documentation, observation, and inference.
assets.overlap: Agent-only definition; doc-updater is a distinct parent write-oriented contract.

assets.name: e2e-runner
assets.purpose: Run a delegated end-to-end scenario in an isolated worktree.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local e2e-runner agent.
assets.outputContract: Changed test artifacts, commands, assertions, and unresolved failures.
assets.mutation: Controlled writes limited to delegated E2E artifacts.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to the e2e-runner parent-context role contract.

assets.name: explorer
assets.purpose: Inspect a bounded repository scope in isolated read-only context.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local explorer agent.
assets.outputContract: Concise file, symbol, dependency, and execution-path evidence.
assets.overlap: Agent-only definition without a parent-context role file.

assets.name: refactor-cleaner
assets.purpose: Perform bounded behavior-preserving cleanup in an isolated worktree.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local refactor-cleaner agent.
assets.outputContract: Changed files, preserved invariants, verification, and remaining risk.
assets.mutation: Controlled write in the assigned isolated worktree.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to the refactor-cleaner parent-context role contract.

assets.name: reviewer
assets.purpose: Provide independent read-only review in a distinct subagent context.
assets.activation: Provision from the shipped asset and spawn explicitly as a project-local reviewer.
assets.outputContract: Severity-ordered evidence-bound findings or an explicit no-findings result.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to the code-reviewer parent-context role contract.

assets.name: security-reviewer
assets.purpose: Provide isolated read-only security review.
assets.activation: Spawn explicitly as the project-local security-reviewer agent.
assets.outputContract: Severity-ordered security findings with concrete evidence and mitigation.
assets.overlap: Native counterpart to the security-reviewer parent-context role contract.

assets.name: architect
assets.purpose: Shape parent-context architecture analysis.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Architecture decision with evidence, tradeoffs, migration, and rollback.
assets.overlap: May map to the architect native agent but is not proof of a spawn.

assets.name: build-error-resolver
assets.purpose: Shape parent-context build-failure diagnosis.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Reproduction, root cause, minimal fix, and verification.
assets.overlap: May map to build-resolver but is not an agent definition.

assets.name: code-reviewer
assets.purpose: Shape parent-context correctness and regression review.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Severity-ordered findings, impact, corrective action, and verification.
assets.overlap: May map to reviewer but is not evidence of independent review.

assets.name: doc-updater
assets.purpose: Keep documentation aligned with verified behavior.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Changed documentation surfaces and their source evidence.
assets.overlap: Parent-only role; docs-researcher is a distinct read-only native agent.

assets.name: e2e-runner
assets.purpose: Shape parent-context end-to-end validation.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Journeys, environment, assertions, artifacts, and failures.
assets.overlap: May map to the e2e-runner native agent but is not proof of a spawn.

assets.name: planner
assets.purpose: Sequence approved work into verifiable slices.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Ordered tasks with files, tests, verification, rollback, and commit boundaries.
assets.overlap: Parent-only role without a native agent definition.

assets.name: refactor-cleaner
assets.purpose: Shape bounded behavior-preserving cleanup in the parent context.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Smell, invariant, minimal refactor, verification, and rollback boundary.
assets.overlap: May map to the refactor-cleaner native agent but is not proof of a spawn.

assets.name: security-reviewer
assets.purpose: Shape parent-context security review.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Severity, path, boundary, evidence, remediation, test, and residual risk.
assets.overlap: May map to the security-reviewer native agent but is not proof of a spawn.

assets.name: tdd-guide
assets.purpose: Enforce RED, minimal GREEN, and refactor discipline in parent context.
assets.activation: Loaded by the orchestrator into the parent context.
assets.outputContract: Failing test, failure reason, minimal implementation, and passing evidence.
assets.overlap: Parent-only role without a native agent definition.
